correctness.rationale: Symmetric PBH applies to −L with independent coordinate columns. Each petal's first sine mode is nonzero for m_i≥3, has zero hub coordinate and opposite values at the two hub neighbors, and extends by zero to an eigenvector on the bouquet. Missing a petal therefore obstructs control irrespective of eigenvalue coincidences. For the proposed actuator set, an invisible eigenvector with zero hub value propagates zero on every petal. Otherwise the common normalized recurrence f_(j+1)=t f_j−f_(j−1) starts at (1,0) and closes at f_m=1. For |t|≥2, the absolute Chebyshev value |U_(m−2)(t/2)| is at least m−1 (also at t=±2), ruling out closure. Independently the recurrence preserves f_j²+f_(j+1)²−t f_j f_(j+1)=1, so f_m=1 forces f_(m−1)∈{0,t}, including t=0 where the options coincide. The hub equation 2(k−1)=(s−1)t contradicts |t|<2 since |s−1|≤k−1. This proves sufficiency for all lengths. For zero forcing each petal needs a nonhub seed; with exactly one each the hub and all initial neighbors of every seed are white, so no force starts. Adding the hub gives forcing chains. Symmetry gives the corresponding observability. The supplied modular certificate was inspected, not run; its full ranks are valid characteristic-zero witnesses, but its deficient ranks alone are not. The verifier explicitly checks sets of size k−1, not all sets smaller than the k+1 upper construction as VERIFICATION.md loosely suggests; the universal analytic lower bound covers size k.

evidence: Eroh–Kang–Yi explicitly give Z(B_n)=n+1 for a bouquet of n≥2 cycles with a cut vertex and credit Chilakamarri–Dean–Kang–Yi (2012). The qualitative-class minimum leader count equaling Z is established in the zero-forcing controllability literature.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The cited bouquet theorem covers the zero-forcing half at the same generality. Qualitative-class controllability imposes a requirement over a matrix family, so its minimum is only an upper bound for the single unit Laplacian and does not imply k actuators for that matrix.

Credit Z=k+1 on the whole bouquet family to prior work, not just the triangle subclass; that component is a known comparator, not the originality basis. value.rationale: The exact actuator optimum and a uniform placement for a natural fixed-Laplacian family give a useful, sharp gap between dedicated-input control and a structural zero-forcing certificate. Removing equal-length or arithmetic restrictions is meaningful because the necessary local obstructions and global hub equation must hold even with coincident or incommensurate petal spectra. It tells a researcher precisely when a hub actuator is avoidable in this family. The already-known forcing count is useful as the comparator but adds no independent value claim.
